coverage.why: Every accounting area except earnings_versus_cash, and the industry lens, carries a gate 'dropped' finding in place of an answer; the financial analysis answers all its sections.

calibration.why: The one surviving accounting verdict ('a working-capital release led by supplier payables flatters it and is a timing effect rather than a repeatable source') matches its earnings_versus_cash anomalies, and each financial reading carries the caveats its anomalies list.

valuation_reading.why: The price_position and market_implied_growth readings were gate-dropped, valuation.reverse_dcf.value is never cited, most_sensitive keeps a single entry, and only summary_ko places the price above the range.
